authority: Independent optional profile; validates attributed record structure, not historical truth.
technical_parents: Version parents are declared frozen technical construction inputs. They do not establish historical derivation, and [] means none recorded, not an original or independent witness.

concepts.label: Historical derivation claim
concepts.definition: An agent's hypothesis that the source version derives historically from the target version; not a technical construction dependency or a continuity assertion.

concepts.label: Supersedes derivation claim
concepts.definition: The source derivation claim supersedes the target derivation claim for the same subject version and agent, retaining both claims without asserting historical truth.

rules.P01: The base package validates and contains both reserved concepts with the exact records above. Other concepts and relations remain permitted under base rules.
rules.P02: Every ep-derived-from relation has two version endpoints. Its agent attributes the hypothesis. Hypothesis cycles or contradictory hypotheses may coexist; no truth verdict is inferred.
rules.P03: Every ep-supersedes relation connects two distinct ep-derived-from relations. The newer/source claim, older/target claim, and supersedes relation have the same agent ID; the claims share the same subject/source version. The supersession graph is acyclic.
rules.P04: Current claims are ep-derived-from relations with no incoming supersedes edge (no ep-supersedes relation targeting their ID). Return every surviving branch sorted by claim ID; order confers no authority. An optional agent or subject filter limits the view without judging other claims.
rules.P05: check_profile_revision first applies base check_revision and profile validation to both packages in a caller-declared shared ID scope. Every prior ep-derived-from and ep-supersedes relation must remain present with its exact record. Correction appends a new claim and explicit supersession edge; removing or rewriting history is E_CLAIM_REWRITE.
rules.P06: All operations are nonmutating. Profile conformance neither approves an interpretation nor authorizes reanchoring; base continuity policy remains separate.

operations.validate_profile: package -> {valid,diagnostics}; include base diagnostics, add profile constraints, no resolution output required
operations.current_derivations: package, optional agent ID, optional subject version ID -> deep-copied list of current derivation relation records sorted by ID; invalid profile or unknown/wrong-type filter rejects with ValueError

limits: No bare withdrawal or negative derivation claim
No automatic preference between concurrent claims
No historical truth, time, external evidence-link, authenticity, or persistent-store guarantee
Base check_revision alone does not enforce this optional profile's append-only history
